candidate: 25 ordered local patches; no FreeCAD commit or submission
finding: The shared OriginalLayer property helper passed Property::Hidden (status index 3) as a PropertyType mask. This combines no-persist and transient flags, so the name appeared during import but reloaded empty from FCStd.
fix: Use the existing PropertyType mask App::Prop_Hidden, keeping the property hidden while allowing it to persist; the helper serves ordinary imported objects, block children and INSERT links.
checks: A generated nested-block test initially passed during import but failed after FCStd save, close and reopen because the outer, nested and child values were empty.

After the helper fix, the two shared outer INSERT links reopen with layer A, the nested INSERT reopens with B, and the three block children reopen with 0, A and B; shared block identity remains intact. A separate save/reopen probe independently repeats those assertions.

The 25-patch chain replays exactly against the pinned source archive and the macOS ARM64 candidate passes all 20 headless tests with no skips or failures. Source-release inventory and refusal self-tests pass. No generated drawing fixture was committed.
limits: This preserves declared names as metadata, not effective layer visibility or grouping, and does not cover per-child layers in fused shapes.
Native GUI rendering, edits, layer-zero inheritance, other platforms and independent producers remain unqualified.
The FreeCAD candidate is a local draft; the project reserves submission and contributor attestations for a human contributor.
